title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Canada-eligible remote roles plus hybrid roles in Ottawa, Kingston, Cornwall and Montréal. Skill scores exclude compensation and commute considerations.
latest_update: Rechecked September 22, 2026 — no Additional-Verification block hit this run; all 9 default title-family passes against Canada-broad, plus Ottawa/Kingston/Cornwall/Montréal reachable-city hybrid passes, completed cleanly. 2 new eligible postings auto-filed.

notes_sections.heading: September 18 validation notes
items: No new unique scored row was added: the accessible fresh Indeed results for Qlik, Sectigo, Clariti, Docebo, Origin, Kinaxis, Carbon60/OpsGuru, Spellbook, Tiger Analytics and Ethicrithm were already retained.
The two EPAM roles remain the strongest actionable matches. The Lead DevOps role closely matches Marc's Azure, Dynatrace, Splunk, incident-management and enablement background.
Caseware and Tyk remain visible but score low because advanced production AWS/EKS/Kubernetes operation is central to the work, triggering the profile's cloud-depth gate.
ANVIL Intermediate DevOps, Sectigo Senior/Principal DevOps and Semios Senior SRE remain confirmed expired and excluded from the actionable count.
Haber's freshly indexed Forward Deployment Engineer role was excluded because it requires repeated 2–3 week on-site mill deployments and pulp/paper process expertise.
Vista's Lead SRE page still could not be fetched and remains unvalidated. No eligible Kingston- or Cornwall-only posting surfaced.

notes_sections.heading: September 19 run — browser-driven (WebFetch still blocked)
items: Confirmed WebFetch/direct HTTP is still 403-blocked for this source (2nd+ consecutive confirmation per job_sources.md); switched to the Claude-in-Chrome browser workaround, which loaded every search and detail page cleanly with no CAPTCHA or block encountered — worth updating check-indeed's Access section to recommend the browser path by default rather than re-discovering this each run.

Ran 3 of the 9 default title-family passes (DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Engineer) against l=Canada broad search; did not run Reliability Engineer, Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer, or Forward Deployed Engineer, nor any of the city-specific passes (Ottawa, Kingston, Montréal, etc.) — a boundary worth closing in a follow-up run.
The three passes run returned heavily overlapping result sets (same ~15 postings resurfacing across DevOps Engineer and Cloud Engineer searches).

Exaion (Montréal, two listings — "Senior Cloud & Infrastructure Delivery Lead" and "Private Cloud Infrastructure Administrator F/H", same team/environment) is the one new eligible candidate — scored from the first, the second was not opened this run (backlog).

ALTEN Canada's "Ingénieur.e de la fiabilité des sites / Site Reliability Engineer" (Montréal, $100,000/year) surfaced again — same company and salary as the "Production Reliability & Support Expert" posting Marc explicitly skipped on 2026-09-18; treated as the same underlying req, not rescored.

Scope-excluded without full scoring: Platform Support Engineer (Surrey BC — 60% fullstack dev, not target family), Tech Lead / Kaseya Senior Staff Network Software Engineer / Home Hardware Azure Cloud Architect / WISSEN Senior DevSecOps Engineer / LMI DevOps Team Lead / CARFAX Senior SW Engineer-DevOps / Buyerlink Senior Platform Engineer (all title-plausible but not opened this run — geography/remote status unconfirmed, backlog for a follow-up pass), Moneris "Manager, SRE and DevOps" (Toronto, formal 3+ years people-management scope), InfoTrack Canada "Cloud Infrastructure & DevSecOps Engineer" (same $130-150K Toronto posting already excluded today via the Job Bank run — cross-source duplicate, not rescored), several industrial/mining/rail "Reliability Engineer" postings entirely unrelated to IT (Alamos Gold, Conuma Resources, Heavy Metal Equipment, Adecco Asset Integrity ×3, Via Rail, Can-Tech) surfaced by the generic "Site Reliability Engineer" query matching on "reliability" alone.
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred.

notes_sections.heading: September 19 (second pass) validation notes
items: Ran Site Reliability Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, Platform Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer, and Forward Deployed Engineer remote-Canada, plus a DevOps Engineer Ottawa city pass. Did not reach Infrastructure Engineer, Reliability Engineer, or DevSecOps Engineer keyword passes, or Montréal/Kingston/Cornwall city passes — boundary for a follow-up run.

"Site Reliability Engineer" and "Forward Deployed Engineer" are dominated by the same non-tech noise pattern already documented on Glassdoor (mechanical/electrical "reliability" roles; offshore/defense/AI-agent "forward deployed" roles).

Confirmed Morson Talent's "Senior Azure Cloud DevOps Specialist" (Ottawa, $89.30/hr) is still live and appears across three separate sources now (original Indeed filing Sep 15, this repo's Glassdoor run Sep 19, this Indeed re-run Sep 19) — same still-open req, not a new posting.

Remote-Canada broad search returned a near-identical result pool across all 6 keywords tried today — Octasic, BMO Financial Group, Wissen Technology (Calgary), Codan/Buyerlink (Victoria BC), CARFAX, and Moneris variants resurfaced under every query, reinforcing that Indeed's own ranking pools DevOps/Platform/Cloud/SRE title families into largely the same inventory rather than genuinely distinct result sets.

notes_sections.heading: September 22 run — full title-family + reachable-city rotation, no verification block
items: All 9 default title-family passes against Canada-broad (Site Reliability Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, Cloud Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer, Reliability Engineer folded into the SRE pass per the persistent industrial-noise finding) plus Ottawa, Kingston, Cornwall, and Montréal reachable-city hybrid passes all completed cleanly — no Additional Verification Required prompt encountered this run, unlike September 21.

Confirmed again that Indeed's Canada-broad title-family searches pool into a heavily overlapping ~15-result inventory regardless of which of the 9 titles is queried (same Tactable/Exaion/Thales/CARFAX/Kaseya/Moneris/Buyerlink set resurfaced across SRE, DevOps, Platform, Cloud, Infrastructure, Azure DevOps, and DevSecOps searches) — consistent with the September 19 finding.

CMHC "Bilingual Advisor, Cloud Infrastructure Design and Engineering" (Ottawa/Montréal hybrid, $129,175.28–$161,469.09/year) is the strongest new find this run — senior Azure/IaC/Docker/Kubernetes/DevOps-enablement authority role at a federal Crown corporation, bilingual requirement plays to Marc's strength. A parallel non-bilingual "Advisor, Cloud Infrastructure Design and Engineering" req (same salary band, same team) also exists — treated as the same underlying opportunity, not separately filed. Security requirement is only "Reliability Status" (routine federal screening, not a hard clearance gate).

Groupe SOI / Optosys "Administrateur Réseaux & DevOps Senior" (Montréal, hybrid, cadence not stated) — real Azure/AWS/Docker/CI-CD/Prometheus-Grafana overlap at senior (5-8yr) level, but leans network/firewall/VPN administration as much as DevOps and no salary disclosed; filed at the score-6 floor. Note: Indeed only exposed this posting as a sponsored/ad-tracking link with no stable `jk=` id — flagged per this file's existing ad-link-instability caveat.

New ineligible/out-of-scope rows logged for completeness: Thales "Senior CloudOps Developer" (Vancouver hybrid — outside reachable range), Thales "AI Solutions Engineer" (Ottawa hybrid but requires Canadian Enhanced Reliability clearance/export-control authorization for military C4ISR work — hard eligibility gate plus total domain mismatch), Tactable "Tech Lead" (Toronto hybrid, required onsite — outside reachable range), Procom "Application Manager – Site Reliability" (Toronto, 3 days/week onsite — outside reachable range), Exaion "Private Cloud Infrastructure Administrator F/H" (Montréal hybrid — real Linux/Ansible/Prometheus overlap but L2/3 support scope is junior-leaning relative to Marc's positioning, plus the same OpenStack/HPC gap already flagged on Exaion's Delivery Lead req), Alten Canada "Administrateur(trice) Linux et DevOps" (Sainte-Anne-de-Bellevue/Montréal — full on-site 5 days/week, $80-115K is below the $120K Montréal FTE floor despite genuine Databricks/CI-CD overlap), Syntronic "Senior Cloud Operations and CI/CD Specialist" (Kanata/Ottawa — mandatory hands-on GCP alongside AWS/Azure hits the GCP hard-gate rule), Bevertec "Microsoft SME - Terraform/GitHub" (Montréal, 4 days/week onsite — Windows Server/AD/Exchange/SQL Server specialist scope, not infrastructure/platform engineering center of gravity), Datanova "Senior Systems Administrator - Hosted Infrastructure" (Montréal, full on-site — Windows-server MSP/helpdesk sysadmin scope, no cloud/DevOps center of gravity, salary not stated).
Kingston and Cornwall city passes both returned zero DevOps/SRE/Platform-relevant results (confirmed genuine zero, not a search failure — a handful of unrelated junior/remote noise rows only).

Did not run the 11-hub remote-discovery rotation (Toronto/GTA, Vancouver, Calgary, Edmonton, Waterloo/Kitchener, Halifax, Winnipeg, Québec City, Victoria) this run — boundary for a follow-up run, though this rotation has historically had low incremental yield once the 9 title-family + 4 reachable-city passes are done.
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, sign-in, or write-side action occurred.
